title: Crestline Fleet Account Repeat Over-Limit Dispute Deductible
content:
On a Crestline Fleet Account, a repeat deductible is taken off the unapproved part of a ticket disputed as an unapproved over-limit ticket.

## Deductible

| Earlier disputes of unapproved over-limit tickets on the account that were resolved with a credit and registered less than twelve whole months before today | Repeat deductible |
|---|---|
| two or more | 100.00 |
| exactly one | 50.00 |
| none | nothing |

The earlier disputes are read from the account's dispute list: disputes whose reason is an unauthorized purchase (an unapproved over-limit ticket), whose status is resolved with a credit, and whose registration date is less than twelve whole months before today. A dispute still open, or one registered twelve or more whole months before today, is not counted.

## Effect on the amount

The deductible is taken off the unapproved part (the part of the ticket above the authorized amount). The amount in dispute after the deductible is never below 0.00 and never more than the invoice amount, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, after the deductible has been taken off.

## Cases (hypothetical figures)

| Unapproved part | Counted earlier disputes | Deductible | Amount in dispute |
|---|---|---|---|
| 260.40 | 0 | 0.00 | 260.40 |
| 260.40 | 1 | 50.00 | 210.40 |
| 260.40 | 3 | 100.00 | 160.40 |
| 80.00 | 2 | 100.00 | 0.00 |

On the boundary of the window: an earlier resolved dispute registered eleven whole months before today counts; one registered twelve whole months before today does not.
